model.relation_assumptions: uniform independent queries; every match contributes a novel row; all failed queries charged; two pair additions per query
model.table_assumptions: full quotient table has n*K^2 states and a fraction f preserves proportional hit probability
model.cost_boundary: pair-add attempts and modular matrix events are distinct units; factor-base construction, target descent, replay and conversion are unmeasured

stop_rule: evaluate exactly the frozen 84 weight/fraction cells and W7 conditional interval endpoints; no solver or challenge dispatch
